data.name: Jalaana
data.gender_notes: Jalaana is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Jalaana means 'gentle, fragrant'. This beautiful name is derived from the Arabic root 'jalil' which means 'noble' and 'sublime'. The name Jalaana carries the meaning “Gentle, Fragrant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jalaana usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, fragrant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the gentle touch of Allah's mercy and grace upon one's life.
data.etymology: Jalaana belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Fragrant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jalaana total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_urdu.meaning: رفعت و علو و ظاہر ہونے والا نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: علم مؤنث کا نام، عربی मूल سے نکلا ہوا، جس کا مطلب ہے رفعت، علو اور ظاہر ہونا، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے ہاں رائج ہے، خاص طور پر پاکستان و ہندوستان میں، جہاں یہ اسلامی ثقافت و تہذیب کا حصہ ہے
